result.reason: The operative language does not reach either the preferred or fallback position. The principal Software and Documentation licence remains expressly non-transferable, does not permit contractor use, and is not transferable to an M&A successor. The escrow-code licence permits contractor exercise, but is not stated to be irrevocable or transferable. Subscription termination protections are also absent. Meanwhile, the redline unnecessarily and materially expands escrow release triggers—using potentially undefined concepts such as “severity 1 failure” and “agreed period”—which is beyond the licence-scope rule and alters unrelated commercial intent.
